sourceObservation: Existing v0.3 source and Windows Native R0 receipt have been checked; this R2 knowledge delta does not claim new native collectors or performance effect.

sources.title: PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX2 structure
sources.claimScope: PrivateWorkingSetSize and SharedCommitUsage fields have specific OS update prerequisites; not universally available on all Windows builds.
sources.applicability: Windows 10 22H2 or Windows 11 22H2 with the specified September 2023 cumulative update or later; verify target build and actual API/SDK availability.

sources.title: Reference sets and system-wide effects on memory use
sources.claimScope: Scenario-bound reference set captures memory touch behavior beyond a single process Working Set; capture may noticeably disturb memory and system performance.
sources.applicability: WPR/WPA scenario collection, not passive single-snapshot monitoring. Native trace collection requires separate consent/cost and trustworthy scenario fixture.

claims.statement: PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX2 exposes PrivateWorkingSetSize distinct from PrivateUsage, but is available only on documented eligible Windows builds/updates; missing support cannot be filled from WorkingSet64.
claims.positive: Exact supported OS/build plus API field present and separately labeled
claims.unknown: Build/update/API unknown => UNAVAILABLE / UNKNOWN, never estimated

claims.statement: Performance counters are diagnostic rather than high-frequency profiling tools; process counter instance names can be non-unique, so name-only longitudinal matching cannot establish process identity.
claims.positive: Sampling at a supported diagnostic cadence with a stable independent process instance key
claims.negative: Poll performance counter more than once per second or equate two same-name processes
claims.unknown: Sampling timestamps, instance identity or counter support absent => do not label a leak trend

claims.statement: PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS_EX.PageFaultCount is cumulative, not a hard-page-faults-per-second counter; distinguishing soft/hard faults requires the appropriate separate event/counter and time interval.
claims.positive: Cumulative fault count is reported as cumulative; hard-fault rate only when independently measured
claims.negative: Report PageFaultCount=1200 as 1200 hard faults per second
claims.unknown: Missing interval or separate hard-page-fault counter => rate UNKNOWN

claims.statement: Windows Performance Analyzer reference sets represent memory touched during a specified workload scenario and account for system-wide effects that a single per-process Working Set omits; WPR capture can itself perturb performance and requires separate authorization.
claims.positive: Reference-set results attributed to exact consented workload with explicit instrumentation cost
claims.negative: Treat reference set as instant RAM usage or run intrusive WPR tracing without consent
claims.unknown: No comparable scenario/trace/consent => skip trace and return UNKNOWN

claims.statement: Data processing time and trusted Host sample-capture time are separate facts; an author supplied analyzedAt or JSON observedAt is not provenance proving when an OS memory sample was taken.
claims.positive: analyzedAt is runtime processing time, sampledAt is separately attested by Host with exact source identity
claims.negative: Reflect caller-chosen observedAt as verified collector timestamp
claims.unknown: No Host-issued capture timestamp => sampledAt UNKNOWN

semantics.ownership: Memory metric and sampling semantics belong to CA-MEMORY-PERFORMANCE; workload/reference-set methodology belongs to CA-PERFORMANCE-OPTIMIZATION; sample-time authority belongs to CA-GLOBAL-CURRENTNESS.
semantics.stopRule: Do not introduce a new Element for each metric. Split a new Element only when it has distinct semantic ownership, separate contract/CQ/SAP oracle and a defensible evolution boundary.
semantics.invalidation: Source/Claim/CQ/SAP changes invalidate only intersecting dependent obligations, affected rules and downstream consumer gate; no indiscriminate whole-root qualification change.
semantics.sourceRevision: Microsoft Learn official locator currentness is not an immutable snapshot; independent reviewer must verify referenced official content.
